en_title: Naughty Dog Will 'Fully Reveal' Intergalactic in 2027, but No Release Window Yet
cn_title: 顽皮狗2027年完整公开《星际：异端先知》，发售时间未定
subtitle: 还要再等一等
opus_summary: 顽皮狗负责人Neil Druckmann表示，工作室将在2027年完整公开《星际：异端先知》，但尚未给出发售时间。团队另有两个处于早期阶段的《最后生还者》项目，尚未确认是否为游戏。

paragraphs.en: Naughty Dog studio head Neil Druckmann concluded this year's "The Last of Us Day" by giving updates on the developer's current projects, teasing two new The Last of Us projects that "will expand the canon of The Last of Us beyond Part I and Part II" without confirming whether or not either one of them is a game, as well as saying that its next game, Intergalactic: The Heretic Project, will be "fully reveal[ed]" next year.
paragraphs.cn: 在今年的「最后生还者日」尾声，顽皮狗负责人Neil Druckmann介绍了工作室目前的项目。他透露，团队正在开发两个《最后生还者》新项目，它们「将把《最后生还者》的正史故事扩展到第一部和第二部之外」，但没有确认其中任何一个是否为游戏。他还表示，顽皮狗将在明年「完整公开」下一款游戏《Intergalactic: The Heretic Project》。

paragraphs.en: Writing on the Naughty Dog blog , Druckmann thanked fans for helping raise over $11,000 for AbleGamers before addressing the status of the studio's ongoing projects. Regarding The Last of Us, which he recently said the developer was "not done" with, Druckmann clarified that previous tease by specifically saying that the team has two TLOU projects on its plate. "We have a couple of very exciting new projects in very early stages – so we can’t say much about them at this point," he said. "I will tell you that both projects will expand the canon of The Last of Us beyond Part I and Part II. The world of The Last of Us means a great deal to us, and we wouldn’t return to it unless we had something meaningful to say. We believe these stories are worth telling."
paragraphs.cn: Druckmann在顽皮狗博客上感谢粉丝帮助AbleGamers筹集了超过1.1万美元(约合人民币7万元)，随后谈到了工作室在开发项目的进展。他此前曾说，顽皮狗还「没有结束」《最后生还者》系列。这次他进一步解释了那番暗示，明确表示团队手头有两个《最后生还者》项目。他说：「我们有两个令人兴奋的新项目，目前都处于非常早期的阶段，所以暂时还不能透露太多。但我可以告诉大家，这两个项目都会在《最后生还者》第一部和第二部的基础上拓展系列的既有故事。《最后生还者》的世界对我们意义重大。除非有值得讲述的内容，否则我们不会重返这个世界。我们相信，这些故事值得讲述。」

paragraphs.en: Regarding Naughty Dog's next game, the sci-fi Intergalactic: The Heretic Project, Druckmann said that the studio will stay quiet for the few remaining months of the year, but "in 2027, that changes. We’ll fully reveal Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet and give you a proper look at Jordan’s wild sci-fi adventure." He also called it Naughty Dog's most ambitious project yet, and asked fans for their patience, perhaps an indirect olive branch to fans who were frustrated by Intergalactic's no-show at the recent Sony State of Play. "There’s an electricity around the studio right now as all the pieces come together, and we’re stoked to finally unveil Intergalactic in all its glory," he said. "But…we need to cook for just a little bit longer."
paragraphs.cn: 谈到顽皮狗的下一款游戏、科幻作品《星际：异端先知》时，Neil Druckmann表示，今年剩下的几个月里，工作室不会透露更多消息，但「到了2027年，情况就不同了。我们会完整公开《星际：异端先知》，让大家好好看看Jordan那场狂野的科幻冒险。」他还称，这是顽皮狗迄今最具野心的项目，并请粉丝耐心等待。这或许是在间接回应那些因《星际：异端先知》缺席近期索尼State of Play而感到失望的粉丝。他说：「随着各个部分逐渐成形，工作室现在充满了干劲。我们也很期待终于能向大家完整展示《星际：异端先知》。但……还得再给我们一点时间打磨。」

paragraphs.en: Druckmann concluded with, "We know it’s been a long time since we’ve had much to share with you. We don’t take your continued support for granted. We’re working incredibly hard to make something worthy of your patience."
paragraphs.cn: Druckmann最后说：「我们知道，已经很久没有太多消息可以和大家分享了。你们一直以来的支持，我们绝不会视为理所当然。我们正在全力以赴，希望做出一部不辜负大家耐心等待的作品。」

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, it looks like the HBO TV series adaptation of The Last of Us will wrap up with the upcoming third season.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，HBO改编的《最后生还者》电视剧似乎将在即将播出的第三季完结。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
